attributes.action: Bring back ADHD medication on the NHS for more
attributes.background: End the stigma of people using a private consultant to manage their care and allow for shared care agreements with GPs and Consultants to be brought back. Paying for your care doesn’t make you well off but it’s become a necessity for many from all walks of life

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition which asks for similar action:

'Review shared care arrangements for ADHD between NHS and private specialists'
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/768351
